tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards: the manage, options and server pages. The logo's cream in light, a green-black night in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the extension popup's ground, menus and the field fill. One step lifted from `page`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: the table header strip, the search field, the selected row, `kbd` keys.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate, never ones that identify a control: card borders, row dividers. Decorative; not a 3:1 boundary.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of text fields, checkboxes and radio dots. Holds 3:1 on `page`, `surface` and `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: topo-line
tokens.usage: Contour lines of the topographic footer only. Decorative: deliberately below any contrast floor.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and go/ names, on `page`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `moss-soft`, `terracotta-soft` and `clay-soft` (11:1 or better in both themes). Forest-tinted, after the logo's wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: owners, labels, hints, URL paths, the `go/` prefix. On `page`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, descriptions in rows. The quietest text; holds 4.5:1 on `page`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The one interactive accent, from the logo's pine and sage. Primary button fill, the checked state, links. As text on `page`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `moss-soft` (6:1+).

tokens.name: moss-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a `moss` button. `on-moss` text stays legible on it.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet sage ground: the selected mode card, the checked segment. Text on it is `ink` or `moss`.

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `moss` or `moss-hover` fill. Dark in the dark theme, because dark `moss` is light sage.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Trail-blaze marker from the logo's warm face: the bar on a just-created or just-edited row, the 'new' dot. Sparingly. As text on `page`, `surface`, `terracotta-soft` (4.7:1+).

tokens.name: terracotta-soft
tokens.usage: The brief highlight behind a row you just made, fading back. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: 'go/bug already exists.', Delete. Redder than `terracotta` so a marker never reads as an error. As text on `page`, `surface`, `clay-soft` (5:1+). Always with words.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error notice and of Delete on hover. Text on it is `ink` or `clay`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Over 6:1 against every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: Logo only: the mark's darkest face and the wordmark on light grounds. Fixed across themes.

tokens.name: brand-pine
tokens.usage: Logo only: the mark's lower-centre face.

tokens.name: brand-sage
tokens.usage: Logo only: the mark's left face. Also the cover.

tokens.name: brand-sage-light
tokens.usage: Logo only: the mark's lit centre face.

tokens.name: brand-peach
tokens.usage: Logo only: the mark's top face.

tokens.name: brand-umber
tokens.usage: Logo only: the mark's top-right face.

tokens.name: brand-terracotta
tokens.usage: Logo only: the mark's right face.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The product name in a page header and the options page title. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings. Sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everyone at your company sees the same links.
styles.usage: Default UI text, inputs, buttons, notices.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and table column headers, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Stored only in this Chrome profile.
styles.usage: Hints under fields, helper copy, timestamps, counts.

styles.name: go-name
styles.usage: Every go/ name, everywhere it appears. `go/` in `ink-muted`, the name in `moss` (lists) or `ink` (prose).

styles.name: url
styles.usage: Destination URLs in rows and previews, in `ink-muted`; truncate in the middle, never wrap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between inline controls; button groups; row action gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; between fields in a form row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding at compact density; popup padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding at default density; between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top margin of a page; empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd keys, checkboxes, badges, the row highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, mode options, the popup's inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots and the density thumb only. Buttons are never pills.

size.note: Density scales. bundle.css maps the active set to --row, --control, --pad by `data-density` on <html>.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Link row height at Compact density.

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Link row height at Default density.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Link row height at Comfortable density (shows the description line).

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Button and field height at Compact; always used in the popup.

tokens.name: control-default
tokens.usage: Button and field height at Default.

tokens.name: control-comfortable
tokens.usage: Button and field height at Comfortable.

tokens.name: popup-width
tokens.usage: Width of the toolbar popup. Fixed.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max content width of the manage, options and server pages.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards rest on `page` with a hairline and this barely-there settle. Never deeper.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, the omnibox suggestion preview, toasts. The only lifted elements.
